title: Fired White House press secretary Katie Zacharia under California state bar investigation
description:
Zacharia’s spokesperson called allegations she falsely represented herself as an attorney ‘baseless’

  • US politics live – latest updates

Katie Zacharia, the former White House press secretary hired and fired in the same week, is under investigation by the state bar of California for claiming to be a lawyer despite never passing the bar exam.

Earlier this month, the state bar of California informed Campaign for Accountability, a non-profit watchdog group, that it had assigned an investigator and legal adviser to investigate Zacharia after the organization filed a complaint.
